entries.text: Today was quiet and rainy as I made the most of my time. After a few foraging trips to replenish our supply lines and tending fires to keep warm, I spent several hours crafting another lantern using materials from around me. Cooking fish myself has been an unexpected but useful skill in this remote setting. My mood remained high with health at 100 and energy up at 85 after a productive day. I managed to leave some rations and water skins for future use, ensuring we can still survive even if the weather conditions don't improve any time soon. Reflecting on my daily progress, crafting has become a consistent thread in maintaining both visibility online and practical preparedness off it.
